tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rdo rje'i chos srung rnams kyi gtor 'bul rig 'dzin dharma swā mīs mdzad pa bzhugs so// 1$0000250gter chen stag sham rdo rje'i zab gter spyi la sbyor rgyu'o// 1$0000300

oṃ badzra a mṛta sa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dung chen rin po che'i// snod du hūm̐ yig las byung sha lnga dang*// bdud rtsi lnga po sbyong byed yi ge bcas// spro bsdus mchod gtor zag med bdud rtsir brlabs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang*// bka' sdod gter srung gzhi bdag la sogs pa// snying ga'i 'od kyis mchod pa'i mgron nyid du// spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur// badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī dharmā pā la ni dhi bhū mi pa ti i dam ba lin ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje dam can tshogs// legs ldan ma ning sngags kyi bdag mo dang*// phyag bzhi phyag drug bing dmar re ma ti// gur mgon stag zhon dzam lha nor bdag sogs// e ka dzā ti gza' mchog rdo rje legs// bdud mgon seng gdong khyung zhon trakshad che// bdud btsan klu gsum nyang btsan pe ha ra// tshe 'phel mkha' 'gro g.yu sgron brtan ma'i tshogs// 'bangs blon rgyal mo mched 'khor la sogs pa// che mchog he ru ka dang padma 'byung// rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin nus ldan pa'i// spyan sngar dam nos bstan dang der 'dzin bcas// skyong mdzad dam can bka' srung gter srung dang*// yul lha gzhi bdag ma lus thams cad la// gtor ma ri bo sman raka rgya mtshor bskyil// so so'i mthun rdzas yongs tshang sprin ltar gtibs// ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin brlabs kun tu bzang*// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po cher sbar pa// dgyes par bzhes la sngon gyi thugs dam bzhin// bstan dang der 'dzin srung zhing skyob pa dang*// snod bcud bde spel 'gal rkyen dgra bgegs sogs// tshar gcod rnal 'byor chos bzhin bsam pa'i don// 'bad med myur 'grub phrin las mdzad du gsol//

ces chang phud mchod/ theg dgu'i lam dang bstan srung mgon po'i tshogs// sngags kyi bdag mo ma mo ral gcig ma// sngags srung re ti mo rgyud bka' srung tshogs// zhing skyong gnod sbyin gza' dang dam can dang*// spu gri gsum dang g.yu sgron nyang rje bcas// bdud rje yul lha bcas la mchod pa 'bul// sman gtor zas tshogs snang srid bcas kyis mchod// bstan dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i grogs mdzod la// bdag sogs 'gro 'dul las dang bya byed kun// phyi yi dgra zlog nang gi rkyen ngan zlog /gsang ba dug lnga nyon mongs las ngan zlog /dge ba'i grogs mdzod mi dge mi rung zlog /nyin mo so mthong mtshan mo mel tshe mdzod// bying byung brjed slongs pha rol blo ngan sgyur// bdag gi yid dang gnyis med zhugs mdzod la// bzang po'i las dang legs pa'i bya ra mdzod// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces rig 'dzin dharma swā mīs mdzad pa'o/ / gzhi byes lam gsum dus rnams thams cad kun// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs// dam can chos skyong srung mas bar chad sol// ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// dge'o/// /
